description: Reads a set-up link’s status. status open means the step has not happened yet; completed means it has, and result says what was set up; expired means its 30 minutes passed; cancelled means it was cancelled or replaced by a newer one. For connect_integrations, result.connector_accounts lists each account saved; when the workspace has several WhatsApp numbers an account is on none of them until the person adds it to a number on the Integrations page in Cosend. Only the person who asked for the link can read it. Read-only.

id.description: The id in the resource path.
